|rulings=* Even if the [[Death Star]] is somehow a battleground (e.g. due to [[Presence Of The Force]]), it does not count as being a battleground system within 2 parsecs of itself.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Tarkin%20Doctrine</ref>
* If there are (for example) 2 applicable systems, this card initiates a single instance of 2 Force loss (not '1 and 1').
* This mandatory action may be initiated by Dark as a top-level action. If both players pass consecutively during Dark's control phase and this hasn't been initiated yet, it initiates itself as an automatic action.
